paite: Jesu'n huai thute agen khit in anungzuite toh apawt ua, Kidron luita akan ua, huai ah huan khat a-om hi. Huai ah amah leh anungzuite alut uhi.
heading: Jesu Matna / (Mat 26.47-56; Mar 14.43-50; Luk 22.47-53)
english: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went out with his disciples over the brook Kidron, where there was a garden, into which he and his disciples entered.

paite: Huan amansak dingpa Judas in leng huai mun athei a; huai ah anungzuite toh Jesu ava tawlnga zelzel uhi.
english: Now Judas, who betrayed him, also knew the place, for Jesus often met there with his disciples.

paite: Huchi in Judas in sepaih pawl, siampu liante leh Pharisaite kiang a om heutute api a, khawnvakte, meiselte, galvante tawi in huai ah ahong pai uhi.
english: Judas then, having taken a detachment of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and the Pharisees, came there with lanterns, torches, and weapons.

paite: Jesu'n atung a thil tung ding tengteng atheigige a, ava pawt a, akiang uah, "Kua ahia na zon uh?" achi hi.
english: Jesus therefore, knowing all the things that were happening to him, went out and said to them, “Who are you looking for?”

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Nazaret Jesu," chi in adawng uhi. Jesu'n akiang uah, "Keimah ka hi," achi hi.
english: They answered him, “Jesus of Nazareth.” Jesus said to them, “I am he.” Judas also, who betrayed him, was standing with them.

paite: Amansakpa Judas leng alak uah adingh a, "Keimah ka hi," achihtak in, anungtolh ua, lei ah apuk duam uhi.
english: When therefore he said to them, “I am he,” they went backward and fell to the ground.

paite: Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Kua ahia na zon uh?" chi in adong nawn hi. Amau, "Nazaret Jesu," achi uhi.
english: Again therefore he asked them, “Who are you looking for?” They said, “Jesus of Nazareth.”

paite: Huan Jesu'n, "Keimah ka hi chih ka hon hilhta a; nou kei hon zong na hih uleh hiaite hoihtak in khah un," achi a adawng hi.
english: Jesus answered, “I told you that I am he. If therefore you seek me, let these go their way,”

paite: "Nang kei na hon piakte khat leng ka mangsak kei," chi a athugen atangtunna ding ahi.
english: that the word might be fulfilled which he spoke, “Of those whom you have given me, I have lost none.”

paite: Huan Simon Peter in anamsau vom adokkhia a siampu lianpen sikha asat a, abil taklam asatkhiaksak hi. Huai sikha min Malkas ahi.
english: Simon Peter therefore, having a sword, drew it, struck the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.

paite: Huchi in Peter kiang ah Jesu'n, "Na namsau apai ah siat in; Pa in nou ahon piak ka dawn kei dia hia?" achi hi.
english: Jesus therefore said to Peter, “Put the sword into its sheath. The cup which the Father has given me, shall I not surely drink it?”

paite: Huchi in sepaih pawl leh Judate heutute'n Jesu aman ua, ahenta uhi.
english: So the detachment, the commanding officer, and the officers of the Jews seized Jesus and bound him,

paite: Annas kiang ah api masa uh, amah Kaiapha sunghpa ahih ziak in. Kaiapha, huai kum a siampu lianpen ahi.
heading: Jesu Siampu Lian Ma Ah
english: and led him to Annas first, for he was father-in-law to Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.

paite: Kaiapha bel, mi tengteng sang a mi khat sih ahoihzaw chi a, Judate hanthawnpa ahi.
english: Now it was Caiaphas who advised the Jews that it was expedient that one man should perish for the people.

paite: Huan Simon Peter in nungzui dang khat toh Jesu azui hi. Huai nungzuipa siampu lianpen meltheih ahi a, siampu lianpen huangsung intual ah, Jesu kiang ah alut sam hi.
heading: Peter In Jesu Akitheihmohbawl / (Mat 26.69-70; Mar 14.66-68; Luk 22.55-57)
english: Simon Peter followed Jesus, as did another disciple. Now that disciple was known to the high priest, and entered in with Jesus into the court of the high priest;

paite: Himahleh polam a kongkhak bul ah Peter adingh hi. Huchi in nungzui dang siampu lianpen meltheih khat ava pawt a, kongkhak ngaknu ahoupih a, Peter apilut hi.
english: but Peter was standing at the door outside. So the other disciple, who was known to the high priest, went out and spoke to her who kept the door, and brought in Peter.

paite: Kongkhak ngak, nungak in Peter kiang ah, "Nang leng hiai mi nungzuite lak a pang sam na hi hia?" achi hi.
english: Then the maid who kept the door said to Peter, “Are you also one of this man’s disciples?” He said, “I am not.”

paite: Ama'n, "Ka hi kei," achi hi. Sikhate leh heutute huai ah adingh uhi. Avot ziak in meihol in mei atoh ua, meilum a-awi uhi. Peter leng akiang uah a-om a, dingh kawm in meilum a-awi sam hi.
english: Now the servants and the officers were standing there, having made a fire of coals, for it was cold. They were warming themselves. Peter was with them, standing and warming himself.

paite: Siampu lianpen in Jesu anungzuite tanchin leh athusinsak adong hi.
heading: Siampu Lianpen In Jesu Thu Dong / (Mat 26.59-66; Mar 14.55-64; Luk 22.66-71)
english: The high priest therefore asked Jesus about his disciples and about his teaching.

paite: Jesu'n adawng a, akiang ah, "Khovel kiang ah vantang theih in, thu ka gen gige hi; sinagog, tempul leh Judate omkhawmnate ah thu ka hilh zel a, asim in bangmah ka gen kei.
english: Jesus answered him, “I spoke openly to the world. I always taught in synagogues and in the temple, where the Jews always meet. I said nothing in secret.

paite: Bang achia kei hon dong? Akiang ua ka thugen ka thuzate dong in, ngai in, amaute'n ka thugen athei uh akei hiam," achi hi.
english: Why do you ask me? Ask those who have heard me what I said to them. Behold, they know the things which I said.”

paite: Huan agentak in akiang a dingh heutu khat in Jesu abeng a, "Siampu lianpen hichibang in na dawng maw?" achi hi.
english: When he had said this, one of the officers standing by slapped Jesus with his hand, saying, “Do you answer the high priest like that?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Thudiklou gen ka hihleh, adiklouhna hon theisak in; himahleh, ka thugen dik ahihleh bang achia hon beng?" achi hi.
english: Jesus answered him, “If I have spoken evil, testify of the evil; but if well, why do you beat me?”

paite: Huan Annas in hensa in siampu lianpen Kaiapha kiang ah asawl hi.
english: Annas sent him bound to Caiaphas, the high priest.

paite: Simon Peter in dingh kawm in meilum a-awi hi. "Nang leng anungzuite lak a pang sam na hi hia?" achi uhi. Ama'n, "Ka hi kei," chi in akitheihmohbawl hi.
heading: Peter In Jesu Akitheihmohbawl Nawn / (Mat 26.71-75; Mar 14.69-72; Luk 22.58-62)
english: Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. They said therefore to him, “You aren’t also one of his disciples, are you?” He denied it and said, “I am not.”

paite: Huan siampu lianpen sikha khat Peter in abil satkhiaksakpa sanggampa'n, akiang ah, "Huan ah ka hon mu kei maw?" achi hi.
english: One of the servants of the high priest, being a relative of him whose ear Peter had cut off, said, “Didn’t I see you in the garden with him?”

paite: Huchi in Peter in akitheih-mohbawl nawn a; huan ak akhuang pah hi.
english: Peter therefore denied it again, and immediately the rooster crowed.

paite: Kaiapha inn a pan in Vaihawmna inn ah Jesu api nawn ua; huai zingsang ahi a; amau ahihleh Vaihawmna inn ah alut kei uh, alut un zaw buah in, Paikan Ankuanglui ane thei kei ding uhi.
heading: Pilat Ma ah Jesu / (Mat 27.1-2,11-14; Mar 15.1-5; Luk 23.1-5)
english: They led Jesus therefore from Caiaphas into the Praetorium. It was early, and they themselves didn’t enter into the Praetorium, that they might not be defiled, but might eat the Passover.

paite: Amaute kiang ah Pilat ava pawt a, "Hiai mi tung ah hekna bang ahia na neih uh?" achi hi.
english: Pilate therefore went out to them and said, “What accusation do you bring against this man?”

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Hiai migilou hi keileh na kiang ah ka hon pi kei ding uh," chi in adawng uhi.
english: They answered him, “If this man weren’t an evildoer, we wouldn’t have delivered him up to you.”

paite: Huan Pilat in akiang uah, "Nou pi unla, na dan bang un vai hawmsak un," achi hi. Judate'n akiang ah, "Kou thu in kuamah hihlup dan bang ahi kei," achi uhi.
english: Pilate therefore said to them, “Take him yourselves, and judge him according to your law.” Therefore the Jews said to him, “It is illegal for us to put anyone to death,”

paite: Hiai thu asihdan ding, Jesu'n agen bang a atangtunna ding ahi.
english: that the word of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spoke, signifying by what kind of death he should die.

paite: Huchi in insung ah Pilat alut nawn a, Jesu asam a, akiang ah, "Judate' Kumpipa na hi hia?" achi hi.
english: Pilate therefore entered again into the Praetorium, called Jesus, and said to him, “Are you the King of the Jews?”

paite: Jesu'n, "Hiai ka tungtang thu nangmah lungsim puakkhiak a na gen hia, midang in hon hilh?" chi in adawng hi.
english: Jesus answered him, “Do you say this by yourself, or did others tell you about me?”

paite: Pilat in, "Kei Juda mi ka hi a hia? Nangmah chipihte leh siampu liante'n ka kiang ah ahon pekhia ua ahi; thil bang ahia na hih?" chi in adawng hi.
english: Pilate answered, “I’m not a Jew, am I? Your own nation and the chief priests delivered you to me. What have you done?”

paite: Jesu'n, "Ka kumpi hihna hiai khovel ahi kei; ka kumpi hihna hiai khovel a hileh Judate kiang a piak a ka omlouhna ding in, ka sikhate'n adou ding uh. Himahleh ka kumpi hihna zaw hiai khovel a kipan ahi kei," chi in adawng hi.
english: Jesus answered, “My Kingdom is not of this world. If my Kingdom were of this world, then my servants would fight, that I wouldn’t be delivered to the Jews. But now my Kingdom is not from here.”

paite: Pilat in akiang ah, "Huchi, nang kumpipa na hi mawleh?" achi hi. Jesu'n, "Kumpipa ka hi na hon chi mah ve. Thutak theihsak ka piansan leh khovel a ka hong paisan ahi. Kuapeuh thutak a om peuhmah in ka thu asang uh," achi hi.
english: Pilate therefore said to him, “Are you a king then?” Jesus answered, “You say that I am a king. For this reason I have been born, and for this reason I have come into the world, that I should testify to the truth. Everyone who is of the truth listens to my voice.”

paite: Pilat in akiang ah, "Thutak bang ahia?" achi hi. Huan huai thu agen khit in, Judate kiang ah ava pawt nawn a, akiang uah, "Bangmah agitlouhna ka mu kei," achi hi.
english: Pilate said to him, “What is truth?” When he had said this, he went out again to the Jews, and said to them, “I find no basis for a charge against him.

paite: Himahleh Paikan Ankuangluina ah mi khat ka hon pawtsakna ding dan na nei uh; huchi in "Judate' Kumpipa hon pawtsak leng na ut uhia?" achi hi.
heading: Jesu Si Ding A Thutanna / (Mat 27.15-31; Mar 15.6-20; Luk 23.13-25)
english: But you have a custom that I should release someone to you at the Passover. Therefore, do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”

paite: Amau akikou nawn ua, "Hiai mi hi kei henla, Barabbas pen hi zaw hen," achi uhi. Barabbas tuh suamhat ahi.
english: Then they all shouted again, saying, “Not this man, but Barabbas!” Now Barabbas was a robber.
